 LA Clippers 43 – 38 Live Oklahoma City Thunder Live Updated 3 minutes ago Thunder vs Clippers LIVE, Score Updates and Play-by-Play in NBA (43-38)
 Follow Oklahoma City Thunder vs LA Clippers live from Intuit Dome: 2026-27 NBA score updates, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander box score stats and play-by-play.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 13, 2026, 11:24 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 11:24 PM ET 11:24 PM ET 3 minutes ago Hachimura and Wagler connect from deep for LA
 Kris Dunn found Keaton Wagler for a three-pointer before Wagler fed Rui Hachimura from deep after Hachimura grabbed a defensive board. Bennett Stirtz answered with a three off a Kenrich Williams pass, and Kris Dunn countered with a layup from Isaiah Jackson. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander then finished inside for Oklahoma City, where Isaiah Hartenstein's offensive rebound preceded a Derrick Jones Jr. foul.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 11:12 PM ET End of the first quarter at Intuit Dome 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 11:20 PM ET 7 minutes ago Mara and Gilgeous-Alexander spark Thunder push
 Oklahoma City opened this stretch with Kenrich Williams lobbing to Aday Mara for an alley-oop dunk before Mara rejected Max Strus. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander then grabbed a defensive rebound and followed his own offensive board with a second-chance tip-in. With 9:33 on the second-quarter clock, those four unanswered points for the Thunder forced a timeout at Intuit Dome.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:15 PM ET 11 minutes ago Half-court possessions between Clippers and Thunder
 Keaton Wagler connects on a floater, set up by Isaiah Jackson. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finishes with a jumper on the pass from Josh Dix.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:12 PM ET 15 minutes ago End of the first quarter at Intuit Dome
 Aday Mara and Brook Lopez each corralled a defensive rebound in the closing seconds as the LA Clippers protected a 33-27 lead over the Oklahoma City Thunder. The first-quarter horn sounds at Intuit Dome, sending Los Angeles and Oklahoma City to the bench after the opening period.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:07 PM ET 20 minutes ago Sanders hits from midrange, Jackson splits at the line
 Kobe Sanders knocked down a pull-up jumper off an Isaiah Jackson pass before Shai Gilgeous-Alexander answered with a pull-up of his own for Oklahoma City. Jackson then fouled Gilgeous-Alexander, who missed both free throws, and Max Strus grabbed the defensive rebound for the LA Clippers. Following an offensive goaltending call and a foul on Aday Mara, Jackson hit one of two at the line.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:03 PM ET 24 minutes ago Strus and Wagler cash in at the stripe for LA
 Max Strus drew a foul on Nique Clifford and knocked down all three free throws for the LA Clippers. Oklahoma City answered when Nikola Topic found Isaiah Hartenstein for a dunk, though Hartenstein fouled on the next trip. Keaton Wagler capitalized by sinking both foul shots before Isaiah Jackson hauled in a defensive rebound at Intuit Dome.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:59 PM ET 28 minutes ago Defensive stops at both ends at Intuit Dome
 4 points in a row for Isaiah Hartenstein: a layup and a floater. Play pauses for a timeout with 4:21 showing in the 1st quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:54 PM ET 32 minutes ago Williams scores inside before Garland's block
 Nikola Topic kept a possession alive on the offensive glass before Kenrich Williams converted a layup off Isaiah Hartenstein's pass for Oklahoma City. Los Angeles answered defensively after a Rui Hachimura turnover when Darius Garland swatted Williams' next attempt at the rim. Hachimura and Williams then combined for five rebounds at Intuit Dome as both defenses controlled the glass in the opening quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:50 PM ET 37 minutes ago Perimeter spacing opens the floor for LA Clippers
 Jared McCain knocks down a three-pointer on the pass from Kenrich Williams. Brook Lopez connects on a three-pointer off an assist from Kris Dunn. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finishes with a jumper. Brook Lopez scores on a three-pointer on the pass from Darius Garland.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:45 PM ET 42 minutes ago Paint touches creating looks in the 1st quarter
 Kenrich Williams finishes with a tip-in. Brook Lopez scores on a floater off an assist from Darius Garland. 4 points in a row for Aday Mara: a dunk and an alley-oop dunk. Derrick Jones Jr. converts a three-pointer, set up by Brook Lopez.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:41 PM ET an hour ago Tip-off at Intuit Dome!
 The first quarter is underway at Intuit Dome in Inglewood with 11:55 on the clock between the LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder. Los Angeles starts Derrick Jones Jr., Rui Hachimura, Brook Lopez, Kris Dunn and Darius Garland. Oklahoma City counters with Isaiah Hartenstein, Aday Mara, Kenrich Williams, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Jared McCain.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:30 PM ET an hour ago Arena ceremony wrapping up ahead of tip-off in Inglewood
 National anthem and arena ceremony are wrapping up at Intuit Dome (Inglewood) during the live KSBI telecast ahead of tip-off between LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder (records: LA Clippers 2-8 , Oklahoma City Thunder 8-4 ). Statistical leaders entering tonight: Darius Garland (LA Clippers, 20.4 Points) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Oklahoma City Thunder, 29.7 Points) .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:25 PM ET an hour ago Teams back out at Intuit Dome ahead of tip-off
 LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder take the court at Intuit Dome (Inglewood) (records: LA Clippers 2-8 , Oklahoma City Thunder 8-4 ) ahead of tip-off on KSBI . Assigned officials: Scott Foster, Natalie Sago and Brandon Adair .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:18 PM ET an hour ago 15 minutes to tip-off at Intuit Dome
 With 15 minutes remaining before tip-off at Intuit Dome in Inglewood, the LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder have returned to their respective locker rooms ahead of the pregame walkout. Referees Scott Foster, Natalie Sago, and Brandon Adair are assigned to work tonight's NBA contest.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:11 PM ET an hour ago Players on the court 20 minutes before LA Clippers vs Oklahoma City Thunder
 Rosters for LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder are out on the court at Intuit Dome (Inglewood) (records: LA Clippers 2-8 , Oklahoma City Thunder 8-4 ) completing shooting and position drills ahead of tip-off. Statistical leaders entering tonight: Darius Garland (LA Clippers, 20.4 Points) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (Oklahoma City Thunder, 29.7 Points) .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:04 PM ET an hour ago Final court check ahead of Clippers vs Thunder
 Players are on site at Intuit Dome as LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder get ready for action in NBA .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:55 PM ET 2 hours ago 30 minutes to tip-off between LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder
 We are 30 minutes from tip-off between LA Clippers and Oklahoma City Thunder (records: LA Clippers 2-8 , Oklahoma City Thunder 8-4 ) at Intuit Dome (Inglewood) on KSBI .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:07 PM ET 2 hours ago Broadcast and venue details: Oklahoma City Thunder vs LA Clippers
 Oklahoma City Thunder and LA Clippers meet at Intuit Dome in Inglewood, with national television coverage on KSBI .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:44 PM ET 3 hours ago Key players and statistical leaders for Oklahoma City Thunder vs LA Clippers
 Star power headlines tonight's matchup between Oklahoma City Thunder and LA Clippers at Intuit Dome.
 LA Clippers statistical leaders: Darius Garland (20.4 points) and Darius Garland (6.9 assists).
 Oklahoma City Thunder statistical leaders: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (29.7 points) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (4.5 assists).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:19 PM ET 3 hours ago Latest injury report and availability update: Oklahoma City Thunder vs LA Clippers
 Here is the latest pregame availability and injury report ahead of Oklahoma City Thunder vs LA Clippers at Intuit Dome (KSBI).
 LA Clippers injury report: Brandon Ingram (F) - Out; Yanic Konan Niederhauser (C) - Out; Bradley Beal (G) - Out; Jordan Miller (G) - Out.
 Oklahoma City Thunder injury report: Thomas Sorber (C) - Out; Ajay Mitchell (G) - Day-To-Day; Jaylin Williams (F) - Out; Cason Wallace (G) - Out.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:56 PM ET 4 hours ago Oklahoma City has 46.8 rebounds a game
 Isaiah Hartenstein averages 10.1 of them. The Clippers' rebounding leader, Isaiah Jackson, has 5.9 a game.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago How to watch Thunder at Clippers
 Tip-off at the Intuit Dome is at 7:30 p.m. PT, 10:30 p.m. ET, 9:30 p.m. CT and 04:30 in Madrid. ESPN lists KTLA and ClipperVision as the Clippers' local options and KSBI and the Thunder App for Oklahoma City.
 Stay with VAVEL for starting lineups, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Gilgeous-Alexander's box score and the last injury news before the opening tip.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Intuit Dome, the line and the season series
 The game is at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, where the Clippers are 2-3 this season. ESPN lists the line as Oklahoma City by 7.5 with a total of 222.5.
 ESPN's matchup model gives the Thunder a 76 percent win probability and the Clippers 24.
 The teams meet three times in the regular season. Oklahoma City won the first game, and tonight is the second. Three of the Clippers' last five games were at home, against Toronto, Miami and New Orleans, and they went 1-2 in them.
 On season scoring, Oklahoma City averages 111.1 points and Los Angeles 112.2. Together that is 223.3, almost exactly the 222.5 total.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago The numbers behind the matchup
 Oklahoma City grabs 46.8 rebounds per game against 40.5 for the Clippers. That is a gap of more than six, and it is the largest difference in this matchup. The Thunder also block more shots, 5.5 against 4.0.
 The Clippers have the edge in assists, 26.7 to 22.5. They take more steals too, 9.9 a night against 7.9 for the Thunder.
 Turnovers are the other big difference. Los Angeles averages 17.8 and Oklahoma City 12.2, a gap of 5.6 per game. At the free throw line, the Thunder shoot 82.6 percent and the Clippers 79.6.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Where both teams stand in the West
 Oklahoma City is in the Northwest Division. Minnesota leads at 9-3, Portland is 8-3 and the Thunder are 8-4, a game behind the Timberwolves. Denver is 6-4 and Utah is 1-11.
 The Clippers are in the Pacific. The Lakers lead at 11-2, Golden State is 8-4 and Phoenix is 5-6. Los Angeles is fourth at 2-8, and Sacramento is last at 1-10.
 Oklahoma City has six more wins than Los Angeles, 8 against 2, in only two more games played. The two teams are in very different places. Oklahoma City is within a game of the division lead and the Clippers are seven and a half games behind the Lakers.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Injury report: long lists on both sides
 The injury list is long on both sides. For the Clippers, Brandon Ingram is out after Achilles surgery, Bradley Beal is out with knee inflammation, and Yanic Konan Niederhauser and Jordan Miller are out after foot and shoulder surgeries.
 For the Thunder, Chet Holmgren is out with a knee injury. Thomas Sorber is out with a knee problem, Jaylin Williams is out with back spasms and Cason Wallace is out after shoulder surgery. Ajay Mitchell is listed day-to-day with an ankle sprain.
 That makes four Clippers and four Thunder players listed as out, with Mitchell the one questionable name. Those are the entries on ESPN's report this morning, so the final lineups come from the teams shortly before tip-off.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Thunder last five: three straight wins, then two losses at Portland
 Oklahoma City opened the stretch with three wins and finished it with two losses.
 The Thunder beat Cleveland 124-116 at home, won 128-97 at Memphis and beat Washington 114-75 at home. The 39-point win over the Wizards is the biggest margin on either schedule. Washington is 4-9 and Cleveland is 6-6. Then Oklahoma City went to Portland and lost 123-103 and 118-108 in back-to-back games.
 In the two losses the Thunder scored 103 and 108, their lowest totals of the five games. Portland is 8-3 and sits second in the Northwest. The Thunder allowed 116, 97, 75, 123 and 118 points over the five games.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Clippers last five: one win, 139 points in it
 Los Angeles is 1-4 in its last five.
 The Clippers lost 124-112 at Golden State and 125-118 to Toronto at home. They lost 117-116 in overtime to Miami at home, then beat New Orleans 139-123 at home. The latest game was a 133-110 loss at Phoenix.
 The one-point loss to the Heat is the one that stings. Golden State is 8-4 now, Miami 5-6 and Phoenix 5-6, so the five games came against opponents on both sides of .500. The win over the Pelicans is the only result in which the Clippers scored more than 118. In the other four games they scored 112, 118, 116 and 110. The Clippers allowed 124, 125, 117, 123 and 133 points over the five games.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Darius Garland carries the Clippers
 Los Angeles has one player who does most of the work. Darius Garland leads the Clippers in points with 20.4 per game and in assists with 6.9. He shoots 46.7 percent from the field and 82.6 percent at the line.
 The cost is turnovers. Garland gives it away 5.0 times per game in 32.6 minutes, which is a big number for a player with the ball in his hands this much. Isaiah Jackson leads the team in rebounds with 5.9 a game. With Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram both on the injury list, the Clippers have fewer scorers around Garland, and his numbers carry more weight.
 The Clippers shoot 38.1 percent from three, the best number in this game, and make 14.1 per night. As a team they score 112.2 points with 26.7 assists. The assist count is the highest between these two teams.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Shai Gilgeous-Alexander drives Oklahoma City at 29.7 points a game
 The Thunder run through Shai Gilgeous-Alexander . He averages 29.7 points on 45.3 percent shooting and he is an elite free throw shooter at 87.1 percent. He also leads the team in assists with 4.5 per game, with only 2.2 turnovers in 32.8 minutes.
 Isaiah Hartenstein is the rebounder, with 10.1 a night, 7.2 of them on the defensive glass and 2.9 on the offensive end. Holmgren, the other big man, is on the injury list, which leaves Hartenstein as the main presence inside.
 Oklahoma City scores 111.1 points per game, a bit lower than the Clippers' 112.2. The Thunder win with rebounding and low turnovers rather than volume. They make 11.0 threes a game at 34.6 percent, the lowest volume in this matchup, and shoot 45.3 percent overall against 45.9 for the Clippers.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:30 PM ET 4 hours ago Thunder visit Clippers in Inglewood, tip-off at 7:30 p.m. PT
 Welcome to VAVEL's live coverage of Oklahoma City Thunder at LA Clippers from the Intuit Dome in Inglewood. Tip-off is at 7:30 p.m. PT, which is 10:30 p.m. ET and 04:30 in Madrid.
 The Oklahoma City Thunder are 8-4 and 3-4 on the road. The LA Clippers are 2-8 and 2-3 at home. The line has Oklahoma City as a 7.5-point favorite with a total of 222.5.
 These two teams have already met once this season and the Thunder won. We will follow every basket, run and substitution from the opening tip.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
